title: Brian Schottenheimer on confidence in Christian Parker: We're still working through the process

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Schottenheimer on confidence in Christian Parker: We're still working through the process
sources.description: One constant of the 2026 Cowboys season has been a focus on defensive coordinator Christian Parker's job security in the wake of losses and things aren't any different in the aftermath of Sunday's loss to the 49ers.
